claims: Several schools and districts in the Richmond, Fredericksburg, and surrounding Virginia/Maryland areas are closed or closing early on Monday, March 16, 2026, due to forecasted severe weather.
Fredericksburg City Public Schools is closed on Monday, March 16, 2026.
Page County Schools has early dismissal at 12:00 PM on Monday, March 16, 2026.
Keys Academy - Augusta is closed on Monday, March 16, 2026.
Keys Academy - Augusta has virtual learning from 9 am to 1 pm on Monday, March 16, 2026.
Mt. Carmel Christian Academy is closed on Monday, March 16, 2026.
Maryland School for the Deaf is closing at noon on Monday, March 16, 2026.
Riverdale Baptist School is closing 2 hours early on Monday, March 16, 2026.
Mount Airy Christian Academy has a 1/2 day schedule on Monday, March 16, 2026.
The Maddux School is closing 2 1/2 hours early on Monday, March 16, 2026.
Sabot School is closing early on Monday, March 16, 2026.
The Steward School is cancelling after-school activities on Monday, March 16, 2026.
